verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers APIs for card expenses (mark as synced after ingesting into ERP/accounting system) and bills/accounts-payable management, plus webhooks for real-time event notifications, which together enable syncing transactions/expenses with accounting software. However, this is API-level plumbing rather than documented native/pre-built integrations with named accounting platforms (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite), and no evidence of automatic bi-directional sync out-of-the-box. Missing for 10: named accounting-software connectors/integrations, evidence of automatic (not just API-enabled) syncing, and independent confirmation of real-world accounting sync usage.
